subject.title: [Bug]: sessions_yield subagent wake can compact parent branch at low context usage

question: Should successful-turn usage-based overflow still trigger auto-compaction when provider usage is internally inconsistent or lacks a trusted context snapshot?
rationale: The safe fix must balance false-positive compactions against silent-overflow recovery for providers that do not hard-fail, and it also changes persisted compaction attribution.

options.title: Sanity-check usage and persist trigger
options.body: Keep successful-turn overflow recovery only for trusted context snapshots or internally consistent usage, add a closed trigger field, and require live subagent-yield proof.

options.title: Disable successful-turn overflow recovery
options.body: Avoid this false-compaction class by relying on explicit provider overflow errors, at the cost of weaker silent-overflow recovery.

options.title: Keep the predicate unchanged
options.body: Preserve current silent-overflow behavior but leave the reported low-context compaction class and weak attribution unresolved.

recommendation.title: Sanity-check usage and persist trigger
recommendation.body: Keep successful-turn overflow recovery only for trusted context snapshots or internally consistent usage, add a closed trigger field, and require live subagent-yield proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Prior adjacent session usage hardening makes this the strongest available routing signal for the usage/accounting policy decision.
